This is a quick run-through.

Press `CMD+SHIFT+I` to add a python block:

```{python}

import subprocess

World = (
        subprocess.run(['git','config','user.name'],
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            )
        .stdout
        .strip()
        .decode()
        )

print(f"Hello {World}.")
```
